categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design and sales of power management ICs and power components (MOSFETs). These products are widely used in high-performance power management for computing devices, industrial applications, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics such as graphics cards, personal computers, smartphones, servers, electric vehicles, and machine tools.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced analog IC design, integrating power management ICs with discrete power components. It develops high integration, high efficiency, and high-density power solutions using advanced semiconductor processes including third-generation compound semiconductor technologies. The company outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to leading foundries and assembly/test partners.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global brands in computing (CPU/GPU platforms), industrial equipment, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves OEMs, ODMs, and system integrators in markets such as graphics cards, personal computers, smartphones, servers, electric vehicles, and industrial machinery.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s sales are primarily concentrated in Asia, especially Taiwan, with minor sales in the Americas. It has overseas investments and operations in China and Japan, and maintains strategic partnerships with global semiconductor supply chain leaders.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as an IC design house without its own wafer fabrication facilities. It relies on foundries for wafer manufacturing and downstream partners for packaging and testing, then sells products to OEMs, ODMs, and system manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-performance, high-density power management ICs and MOSFETs for emerging applications such as AI computing, 5G, automotive electronics, and industrial automation. R&D focuses on advanced packaging, monolithic power ICs, GaN power devices, and expanding product lines from consumer to industrial and automotive specifications. The company also emphasizes sustainability and green energy technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power management ICs and discrete power components. The company also engages in strategic partnerships and licensing arrangements to enhance product offerings and market reach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major global competitors include Infineon, ON Semiconductor, Toshiba, STMicroelectronics, and Vishay. Domestic competitors include Silicon Motion (矽力-KY), ChipMOS, and others. The company differentiates itself by offering both power management ICs and discrete MOSFETs, providing integrated power solutions with strong technical and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$3.7 billion, a 21.7% increase year-over-year, with a gross margin of 30.3%. Net profit after tax was about NT$230 million, showing significant growth. The company maintains a strong financial position with increasing assets and equity, supported by private placements and convertible bonds to fund growth and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing comprehensive, high-density power solutions that meet the demands of top-tier global customers. Its unique value lies in combining power management ICs with discrete power components, enabling high integration, efficiency, and performance. It focuses on customization, advanced technology adoption, and strong customer collaboration to deliver competitive, cost-effective products tailored to diverse applications.
